C1022.title: Man Sentenced to 7 Years and 3 Months for Using AI Face-Swapping to Fabricate Pornographic Videos of Female Celebrities
C1022.summary: In November 2023, an individual surnamed Yu in Hangzhou was convicted for using AI face-swapping software to create and distribute a large volume of pornographic videos.
